name: Sticky Sections Fling
description: Full-screen sticky panels that get flung off sideways with rotation, scale and dimming as the next panel scrolls in, with an image contrast fade, intro hero and closing statement.
contents: Stack of sticky full-screen panels with counter, image, title and text
Fullscreen loader shown until images are ready
behavior: Each panel pins at the top and scrubs away with horizontal shift, rotation, scale and brightness dimming
Panel direction alternates left and right
Last panel drops down instead of sideways
Panel images shrink while their contrast eases from high to normal
Smooth scrolling through Lenis, skipped when reduced motion is preferred

props.name: heroDescription
props.default: As data conglomerates reveled in the opulence of cognitive wealth, a silent underclass manifested, condemned to the digital periphery.

props.name: outro
props.default: Lost in perpetual dependency, inhabitants of the Synthetic Era found solace in cryptic simulations, where pain ebbed and cognitive loads momentarily lightened.

editableByProps: All hero, panel and outro text, images and panel colors
Background, text and loader colors, corner radius and image size
Fling angle, distance, scale, dimming, transform origins and scroll lengths
Smooth scroll on or off and its smoothness, loader on or off

needsCodeEdit.change: Change panel counter format or position
needsCodeEdit.where: pad function and the span with tabular-nums in the sections map
header and section elements around the panel list

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when smoothScroll is on, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Panels are full viewport height and need scroll room provided by the pinned stack
Loader covers the viewport until images load
